stem: How did the states work to lessen the effects of the Great Depression shown in this diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: By refusing to accept federal money for relief programs and demanding more laissez-faire policies

options.label: B
options.text: By agreeing to let the federal government nationalize industries to bring stability to the national economy

options.label: C
options.text: By stopping the federal government from collecting federal income taxes to give people more money to spend in the states

options.label: D
options.text: By accepting federal money for relief programs but maintaining control over the administration of the programs

visual_elements: Effects of the Great Depression on Local Governments
notes: Includes diagram showing effects on local governments with three boxes linked to main idea.
